name: ffxiai
description: Let Claude see your Final Fantasy XI characters: gear, inventory, party, merits, currencies and more. Needs the FFXI-AI Windower addon.
long_description:
Connects Claude to the **FFXI-AI** addon for Windower, so you can ask things like *"What augments are on my cape?"*, *"Which of my rings have Store TP?"* or *"How many Sparks do I have?"*.

**Read-only.** Claude can look, never act: it can't move, fight, trade or send anything in game. Chat reading is off until you turn it on in game (`//ffxiai chat on`).

**Before you start:** install the FFXI-AI addon in Windower and load it on every character (`//lua load ffxiai`). This extension only connects Claude to it.

Works with several characters at once: ask about one by name, or all of them.

port.title: Port
